name: Undead Disciple
body:
Children born from dead mothers, dhampirs, masters of undead, priests of death gods, all of these can answer the call of the grave and become undead disciples.

Requirements

To qualify to become an undead disciple, a character must fulfill all the following criteria.

Race: Cannot be a creature of the undead type.
Skills: Knowledge (religion) 5 ranks.
Languages: Necril.
Spellcasting: Able to cast either animate dead or death knell. A sorcerer or bloodrager with this prestige class must have the undead bloodline. If the character gains levels of sorcerer or bloodrager after taking this class, she must take the undead bloodline.
Class Skills

The undead disciple’s class skills are Intimidate (Cha), Knowledge (arcana, religion) (Int), Perception (Wis), Sense Motive (Wis), Spellcraft (Int), and Stealth (Dex).

Skill Ranks at Each Level: 2 + Int modifier.

Hit Die: d8.

Table: Undead Disciple
Level	Base Attack Bonus	Fort Save	Ref Save	Will Save	Special	Spells per Day
1st	+0	+1	+0	+1	Blood of the grave, detect undead, natural armor increase +1	—
2nd	+1	+1	+1	+1	Ability boost (Con +2), bloodline feat, fearful touch	+1 level of existing spellcasting class
3rd	+2	+2	+1	+2	Death’s gift, undead form (1/day)	+1 level of existing spellcasting class
4th	+3	+2	+1	+2	Ability boost (Con +2), natural armor increase +2	+1 level of existing spellcasting class
5th	+3	+3	+2	+3	Bloodline feat, darkvision 30 ft.	+1 level of existing spellcasting class
6th	+4	+3	+2	+3	Ability boost (Str +2)	+1 level of existing spellcasting class
7th	+5	+4	+2	+4	Natural armor increase +3, undead form (2/day)	+1 level of existing spellcasting class
8th	+6	+4	+3	+4	Ability boost (Wis +2), bloodline feat	+1 level of existing spellcasting class
9th	+6	+5	+3	+5	Incorporeal form	+1 level of existing spellcasting class
10th	+7	+5	+3	+5	Darkvision 60 ft., undead form (3/day)	+1 level of existing spellcasting class
Class Features

All of the following are class features of the undead disciple prestige class.

Weapon and Armor Proficiency

Undead disciples gain no proficiency with any weapon or armor.

Spells per Day

At the indicated levels, an undead disciple gains new spells per day as if he had also gained a level in a spellcasting class he belonged to before adding the prestige class. He does not, however, gain other benefits a character of that class would have gained, except for additional spells per day, spells known (if he is a spontaneous spellcaster), and an increased effective level of spellcasting. If a character had more than one spellcasting class before becoming an undead disciple, he must decide to which class he adds the new level for purposes of determining spells per day.

Blood of the Grave

An undead disciple adds his level to his sorcerer or bloodrager levels when determining the powers gained from his bloodline. A character with levels in both bloodrager and sorcerer must choose which class stacks with his undead disciple levels to determine his bloodline powers. If he does not have levels in sorcerer or bloodrager, he instead gains bloodline powers of the undead sorcerer bloodline, using his undead disciple level as his sorcerer level to determine the bonuses gained. This ability does not grant bonus spells to a sorcerer or bloodrager unless he possesses spell slots of an appropriate level. Such bonus spells are automatically granted if the sorcerer or bloodrager gains spell slots of the spell’s level.

Detect Undead (Su)

An undead disciple can detect undead at will, as the spell. If the undead disciple already possesses this ability, its range increases instead to 100 feet.

Natural Armor Increase (Ex)

At 1st, 4th, and 7th level, an undead disciple gains an unnatural protection from attacks, causing a cumulative increase to his natural armor bonus of +1.

Ability Boost

As his body becomes more and more a vessel for otherworldly forces, an undead disciple gains stat boosts as noted on Table 18: Undead Disciple. These increases stack and are gained as if through level advancement.

Bloodline Feat

Upon reaching 2nd level, and every three levels thereafter, an undead disciple receives one bonus feat, chosen from the sorcerer undead bloodline’s bonus feat list or from the bloodrager undead bloodline’s bonus feat list, depending on which one he is advancing with his level progression.

Fearful Touch (Su or Sp)

At 2nd level, when the undead disciple uses his grave touch or frightful charger bloodline power, his target is frightened for a number of rounds equal to 1/2 his equivalent sorcerer or bloodrager level. Upon reaching 6th level, the victim becomes panicked instead.

Death’s Gift (Ex)

At 3rd level, an undead disciple gains the death’s gift bloodline power, even if he doesn’t normally possess that power. Once his level is high enough to grant this ability through the bloodline, his cold resistance and DR against nonlethal damage increase by 5 points each.

Undead Form (Sp)

At 3rd level, an undead disciple can assume some aspects and powers of true undead once per day. This ability works like undead anatomy I. At 7th level, this ability functions as undead anatomy III and can be used twice per day; at 10th level, it functions as undead anatomy IV and the undead disciple can use this ability three times per day. His caster level for this effect is equal to his effective sorcerer or bloodrager levels for his undead bloodline.

Darkvision (Ex)

At 5th level, the undead disciple gains darkvision with a range of 30 feet. If he already possessed darkvision, the ability range increases by 30 feet instead. At 10th level, the undead disciple adds another 30 feet to his darkvision range.

Incorporeal Form (Sp or Su)

At 9th level, the undead disciple gains the incorporeal form ability of the sorcerer undead bloodline or the incorporeal bloodrager ability of the bloodrager undead bloodline (depending on which one he is advancing with his level progression), even if he doesn’t normally possess that power. Once his level is high enough to grant this ability through the bloodline, he can instead use it 2 times per day.
